MediaKind.description:
What a job *does*, as ``<output domain>.<operation>`` — mutually exclusive by construction.

generate = new content from prompts/refs, edit = transform existing content under instruction,
enhance = fidelity-only change (upscale/interpolate/denoise), analyze = produces judgments/text.
Sub-modes (t2v/i2v/first-last/reference...) are ``params['mode']``, not new kinds.
i18n keys: ``media.kind.<value>``.
MediaKind.title: MediaKind

QualityTier.description:
Draft -> preview -> final: AIGC is a lottery, so iterate cheap and render dear once.

stage; ``eta_sec`` is None until enough has run to estimate.

SpecEdit.description: Only the fields that are sent change. ``params_patch`` merges into params; ``params`` replaces them.

get.description:
SSE feed of job changes (`event: job`, data = JobOut) and story-workflow progress (`event: workflow`, data =
WorkflowRunOut with its live `progress`). Reconnect with `?after=<last id>` to catch up.
`timeout` (seconds) closes the stream after that long; 0 = until the client disconnects.
Same report as `storyagent media healthcheck` (probes services, tools, models, disk).
The flat message catalog, so the web client uses the same keys and texts as the backend.
